findings.title: Sensitive data file world-readable: data/hr_irm_sealed.json (mode 644)
findings.description: data/hr_irm_sealed.json has permissions 644 — the world-readable bit is set. This file contains sensitive trading or governance data and should be readable only by the owner.
findings.proposed_fix: Run: chmod 640 data/hr_irm_sealed.json  (or 600 for most sensitive files)
